settings.heading: Find your perfect mattress in 60 seconds
settings.subtext: A few quick questions — your answers shape which questions come next, so you'll never answer anything irrelevant. We'll match you to the right REM-Fit hybrid and the right size.
settings.data_badge: 📊 Powered by sleep data from 105,165 UK sleepers

settings.title: Who's the mattress for?
settings.subtext: This changes which questions we ask — and which sizes we suggest.
settings.opt_2_hint: We'll factor in movement between you
settings.opt_3_hint: We'll keep it simple and value-focused

settings.title: How do you usually sleep?
settings.subtext: Position decides how much pressure relief vs. support you need.
settings.proof_text: of the 105,165 UK sleepers we've surveyed say motion isolation matters when sharing a bed
settings.proof_sub: Pocket springs isolate movement — we'll factor this in
settings.opt_1_hint: Shoulders and hips take the pressure
settings.opt_3_hint: Needs a firmer surface to keep hips level

settings.title: And how does your partner sleep?
settings.subtext: If you sleep differently, we'll find the best compromise tension — and be upfront about the trade-off.

settings.title: Do you wake with hip or shoulder pressure?
settings.subtext: Side sleepers concentrate weight on two points — the right comfort layer makes all the difference.
settings.proof_text: of UK sleepers are side sleepers — you're in the majority
settings.proof_sub: From our survey of 105,165 UK sleepers
settings.opt_1_hint: Sore hips or shoulders in the night or morning

settings.title: How does your back feel in the morning?
settings.subtext: Be honest — this is the single biggest factor in getting your support level right.
settings.proof_text: of UK sleepers we surveyed said back pain affects their sleep
settings.proof_sub: From our survey of 105,165 UK sleepers
settings.opt_2_hint: Takes a while to loosen up
settings.opt_3_label: Sharp pain or a disc issue
settings.opt_3_hint: Diagnosed or suspected — e.g. sciatica, herniated disc

settings.title: Which best describes your build?
settings.subtext: Support needs change with body weight — heavier builds need a firmer core to stay aligned; lighter builds sink in less, so a softer feel works harder.

settings.title: Roughly, what's your combined weight?
settings.subtext: Pocket springs are rated by the load they carry — this only affects the support engineering we recommend. Skip it if you'd rather not say.

settings.title: Do you sleep hot?
settings.subtext: Overheating is one of the biggest causes of broken sleep in the UK.

settings.title: What feel do you prefer?
settings.subtext: We'll balance this against your support needs — if they conflict, we'll explain why in your result.
settings.proof_text: of UK sleepers we surveyed prioritise temperature regulation
settings.proof_sub: We'll weight cooling comfort layers in your match
settings.opt_4_hint: We'll base it on your answers so far

settings.title: Any preference on comfort materials?
settings.subtext: All our hybrids are built on full-height pocket springs — the comfort layer on top is where they differ.
settings.opt_1_hint: Moulds to relieve pressure points, with an open structure that breathes instead of trapping heat

settings.title: What size do you need?
settings.subtext: All sizes come with free delivery and the 100-night trial.

settings.title: How would you describe the bedroom?
settings.subtext: A bed should leave roughly 60–75cm of walking space on each open side.
settings.opt_1_hint: Box room or snug double bedroom

settings.title: Roughly what's your budget?
settings.subtext: We'll recommend the best match within it — and show you what a small stretch would get.
